stem:
A student heats 250 milliliters of water in a cup to approximately 50 ºC and adds 6 grams of salt. The mixture of salt and water is then stirred for 15 seconds.

Which results will the student MOST LIKELY observe after the mixture has been stirred for 15 seconds?

options.text: The salt will sink to the bottom of the cup.
The salt will float on the water.
The water will change from clear to opaque white.
